item.tib: bka' gsang mkha' 'gro'i snyan rgyud gu ru'i thugs bcud las bla ma zhi ba'i sgrub gzhung 'phrul gyi me long
item.coloph: ma 'ong mthar thug skal pa'i dus tshod la/ sngon chad dus dang skal pa cung mi 'dra/ rgyal khams mnga' ris nad mug mtshon gyi (gyis) 'geng*/ skyabs med 'gro ba kun kyang snying re rje/ de dus bdag med kho bo rnal 'byor bdag 'phag btsun g.yung drung bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bya/ gsang mtshan mi 'gyur pad+ma g.yung drung zhes/ chu pho stag lo sta zla'i tshes bcu la/ nub phyogs u rgyan dur khrod chen po nas/ ma cig yum chen thugs rje kun grol ma'i/ zhal mjal lung bstan gsang ba'i snyan rgyud thob/ phyi rabs don du zab mo gser 'dra zhus/ man ngag phyi rabs don la yi ger btab/ nyes skyon thugs dang 'gal ba ci mchis pa/ ma sring mkha' 'gro'i thugs la bzod par gsol/ dus kyi mtha' la sangs rgyas bden pa'i bon/ phyogs bcu kun khyab 'gro don rab rgyas nas/ mtha' yas 'gro rnams sangs rgyas thob par shog ces gsungs so/ shing 'brug bya zla'i tshes grangs yar ngo la/ slob dpon g.yung drung ye shes gtsor byas nas/ grogs mchog bon gshen rnams kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ phyi rabs don la bka' chab yi ge bkod/ mtha' yas 'gro kun sangs rgyas sa lam bsgrod/ rig 'dzin don rtogs gtso 'khor gcig skyes nas/ g.yung drung bon 'khor phyogs bcur dar rgyas 'phel/ dge ba'i dad dpon chen por bdag gyur nas/ gdul bya nam mkha'i ngang du rgyas pa dang / mi nub rgyal mtshan dbus nas 'dzug par shog ces pa 'di ni dben gnas me ri khrod du gtan la phab pa dge legs 'phel//
